Try a couple more approaches: maybe there's an HTTP API behind read_document accessible via localhost? Probably not; the tool is on the host side. Check listening ports quickly.

Also maybe the document index gets written when a read is attempted — check /registry/document-index for a new worker dir (worker-e3602a44d1f9) recording bytes for cedar docs. If the index records bytes even on failure, that hints the doc exists but not readable. Let's check.
